name: Le banquet Fantômatique de Yômu
source:
Yuyuko wants to organize a festival, and as luck would have it, Youmu's stuck handling everything!

Unfortunately, she's both short on staff and budget! Luckily for her, Lunasa will be there to help her.

[From [url=https://ezo2.itch.io/youmu-ghostly-festival]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
幽幽子想办一场庆典，而妖梦偏偏得负责一切！

不幸的是，人手和预算都不够！好在，露娜萨会来帮忙。

[摘自[url=https://ezo2.itch.io/youmu-ghostly-festival]itch.io[/url]]
